title: Unity CLI Response Envelope
description: Unified response envelope for CLI commands. Field names are camelCase; successful command payloads live under data, structured failures live under error.

data.description: Command-specific result payload. For C# tools this is serialized from the Result DTO.

logsRef.description: Path or reference to the full execution log, when available.

jobId.description: Job identifier for async/long-running commands. Present when the command was dispatched as a job.

error.description: Structured error details. Recovery guidance is nested under error.nextActions and transient retry delay under error.retryAfterMs.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock execution time in milliseconds (including time until error).
